min_fan_speed.description: Minimum fan speed in RPM. Set to 0 for percent-based control (0–100%).

max_fan_speed.description: Maximum fan speed in RPM. Set to 100 for percent-based control.

temp_thresholds.description: Temperature thresholds per sensor zone in °C. Keys are sensor names (e.g., cpu, gpu, chassis); values are temperatures triggering fan increases.

hysteresis.description: Seconds to wait before changing fan speed after crossing a temperature threshold (prevents rapid oscillation).

poll_interval.description: How often (in milliseconds) to read sensor and fan status.

fan_mode.description: Control mode: 'auto' lets macfanctld adjust fan speeds; 'manual' sets fixed speeds based on min_fan_speed/max_fan_speed.

sensor_source.description: Source for temperature readings. 'smbios' is recommended for most MacBooks.

custom_sensor_map_path.description: Path to a custom YAML or JSON file mapping hardware sensors to names (e.g., /etc/macfanctld/sensors.yml). Leave empty to use defaults.

fan_offset.description: Offset added to computed fan speed for fine-tuning (useful if fan tachs are misreported).

fan_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to computed fan speed (e.g., 1.05 to increase by 5%).

critical_temp.description: Temperature (°C) at which fans spin at maximum speed and warnings are logged.

shutdown_temp.description: Dangerous temperature (°C) triggering forced system shutdown to prevent hardware damage.

fan_sleep_mode.description: When enabled, reduces fan speed during system sleep/suspend to minimize noise.

ignore_sensor_failure.description: If true, daemon continues even if one or more sensors are missing or unreadable.
